authority_boundary: Required CLI admission-sha256/queue-token-sha256/authority-ref are independently supplied by the exact separately reviewed honest parent launch. JSON cannot self-grant. Not hostile-caller authentication.
file_pin_requirements: 2..64 unique path rows; exactly one gcc role for historical pinned driver and one shell role /bin/sh with actual alias target; additional observed candidate/loaded-file rows are identity only, not complete loader closure. All numbers/digests concrete and independently reviewed.
context_pins: Exact dict path->path_facts(path) list. Required paths = all file_pin paths UNION controller_cwd, run-root, probe_root, child_cwd, probe/B-prefix and four fixture full paths. path_facts observes lstat each component; directory fields path/dev/ino/mode/uid/gid; symlinks add target/size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns; regular files add size/mtime_ns/ctime_ns. Endpoints only, no lifetime admission.
fixtures: Exact literal fixture_manifest pins derived from v1; not caller-configurable.
expiry: Concrete timezone-aware future ISO timestamp, reviewed independently
controller_and_pilot_hashes: Actual repaired pilot_controller_v3.py and PILOT-v3.json byte hashes must be used; independent parent exact launch pins the resulting ADMISSION/token digests and authority ref. Oldv2 source pins cannot authorize v3.
repair_effect: Top-level admission fields/path/context/limits/fixtures unchanged; native schema value and source/PILOT hashes advance to v3. repair_used belongs to REPAIR-PLAN/PILOT, not an extra ADMISSION field.
